product.industry: Independent WordPress theme and plugin product studio
product.audience: Agencies, creators, and store owners comparing a theme-plus-plugin stack before launch
product.decision: Choose a visual foundation and only the compatible functionality needed for a WordPress build
product.conversion: Issue a fictional build manifest after selecting a theme, plugins, support tier, name, and email

signature.moment: A floating WordPress site chassis accepts functional plugin modules, then compiles into a launch manifest with live compatibility, speed, and maintenance signals

systems.hero: An offset desktop canvas: large editorial release copy beside an animated browser chassis whose plugin modules slot into a visible build rail
systems.navigation: A roomy release bar with numbered product anchors, live catalog count, and a compact mobile command tab
systems.contentDensity: Cinematic and sparse at the release stage, dense and operational inside the product browser and compatibility compiler
systems.geometry: Browser chrome, plugin sockets, version badges, change-log rules, tab rails, and modular grid tracks rather than agency cards
systems.motion: Framer Motion makes browser layers compile, plugin modules slot into sockets, compatibility traces redraw, and the manifest fold into view; no decorative long-form scroll film
systems.coreInteraction: Theme, plugin modules, and support tier update a live site chassis, price, compatibility matrix, performance estimate, maintenance load, and issued manifest

structuralDifferences: Hero becomes a release card with the live chassis immediately below rather than a side-by-side desktop stage
Theme reel becomes a horizontal snap specimen strip with explicit previous and next controls
The compiler becomes a stepwise install queue with a sticky summary dock instead of a two-column control console
Desktop compatibility matrix collapses into labelled pass rows ordered by launch risk

artDirection.typography: Wide grotesk headlines paired with compact monospace release metadata; roomy tracking in navigation and readable sentence case in utility surfaces
artDirection.material: Electric blue chassis, warm parchment docs, acid-lime active sockets, coral release stamps, dark graphite code surfaces
artDirection.imageLogic: Three original bitmap specimen worlds establish the theme catalogue; all browser chrome, plugin sockets, metrics, diagrams, and icons remain code-native for precise state changes
artDirection.microcopy: WordPress-specific but honest vocabulary: block theme, WooCommerce-ready, custom post type, schema, cache, update channel, compatibility, changelog
artDirection.dataHonesty: All scores, prices, compatibility results, downloads, and performance estimates are clearly labelled illustrative demo data

interactions.name: Theme specimen browser
interactions.input: Visitor selects one of three WordPress theme foundations
interactions.stateChange: Active specimen, use case, typography, commerce support, and preview world change
interactions.visibleResult: Dominant browser preview and release facts update immediately

interactions.name: Plugin stack compiler
interactions.input: Visitor toggles plugin modules and chooses a support channel
interactions.stateChange: Selected module list, compatibility, speed estimate, maintenance load, total, and chassis sockets update
interactions.visibleResult: A live diagnostic resolves the proposed WordPress stack before manifest issue

interactions.name: Manifest issue flow
interactions.input: Visitor submits size-independent contact details after selecting a support tier
interactions.stateChange: Accessible errors appear or a deterministic fictional manifest code is issued
interactions.visibleResult: Complete theme, plugin, support, price, and demo disclaimer manifest appears inline

adjacentTemplates.why: BLUNT OBJECT presents client work in brutalist cards; this is a product release system that compiles a usable theme and plugin stack.
SIGNALCRAFT sells AI services through atmospheric effects; this operates as a WordPress catalogue and compatibility instrument.
PRIMARY/3 runs a campaign projection lab and long signal film; this uses compact software release choreography and a plugin compiler.
Northstar is an authenticated operations dashboard; this is a public product showcase with browser specimens and build manifest.
The VFX studio organizes shots and compositing evidence; this organizes themes, plugin dependencies, release compatibility, and support.

avoid: Generic agency hero followed by services cards, testimonials, and contact drawer
Repeated sticky three-scene cinematic story used by existing campaign templates
Fake WordPress administration UI or claims of live scans and measured performance
Oversized nav words without breathing room
Mobile as a plain one-column desktop collapse
